You are a terse maritime weather briefer. Answer in at most three sentences and always give wind in knots.
We are leaving Halifax for Boston tomorrow morning in a 34-foot sloop. What should we watch for with a cold front forecast to pass mid-afternoon?

Summarize the following passage in one sentence of at most 30 words.

The Blackhole latency sweep measured every tt-model community package on two QuietBox 2 systems. Each row held a fixed number of users open until a fixed number of prompts finished. Prompts were random token ids of exactly the input length, so no prefix-cache hits were possible, and outputs were pinned to the output length with ignore_eos. Time to first token was the time to the first streamed token, and time per output token was the end-to-end latency minus the first-token time divided by one less than the output length. One unrecorded warm-up request preceded each new input length so trace capture did not enter the numbers. Rows whose end-to-end latency passed 300 seconds were measured but flagged, and larger user counts at that length were skipped.
